====================
Variable path parses a balanced subexpression
====================

Copy-Item $PSScriptRoot/"$(Get-Date)" $dest

---

(program
  (statement_list
    (pipeline
      (pipeline_chain
        (command
          command_name: (command_name)
          command_elements: (command_elements
            (command_argument_sep)
            (generic_token
              (sub_expression
                statements: (statement_list
                  (pipeline
                    (pipeline_chain
                      (command
                        command_name: (command_name)))))))
            (command_argument_sep)
            (array_literal_expression
              (unary_expression
                (variable)))))))))

(program

====================
Variable path rejects an unclosed subexpression
:error
====================

Copy-Item $PSScriptRoot/"$(Get-Date" $dest

---



====================
Hyphenated command continues across a backtick newline
====================

Get-Date`
| Write-Output

---

(program
  (statement_list
    (pipeline
      (pipeline_chain
        (command
          command_name: (command_name))
        (command
          command_name: (command_name))))))

================================================================================
Literal dollar and hash in expandable path segments
================================================================================
Copy-Item $root/"file$.txt" $dest
Copy-Item $root/"#1.zip" $dest

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (statement_list
    (pipeline
      (pipeline_chain
        (command
          (command_name)
          (command_elements
            (command_argument_sep)
            (generic_token)
            (command_argument_sep)
            (array_literal_expression
              (unary_expression
                (variable)))))))
    (pipeline
      (pipeline_chain
        (command
          (command_name)
          (command_elements
            (command_argument_sep)
            (generic_token)
            (command_argument_sep)
            (array_literal_expression
              (unary_expression
                (variable)))))))))
